title: FizzBuzz
prompt:
Write `fizzbuzz` for a number `n`:

- a multiple of 3 **and** 5 -> `FizzBuzz`
- a multiple of 3 -> `Fizz`
- a multiple of 5 -> `Buzz`
- anything else -> the number as text

```text
fizzbuzz(3)  -> Fizz
fizzbuzz(10) -> Buzz
fizzbuzz(15) -> FizzBuzz
fizzbuzz(7)  -> 7
```

Signature: `function fizzbuzz(n)`
hints: A number is a multiple of 3 when `n % 3 == 0` (the remainder after dividing is 0).
Check the "both" case first. If you test for 3 before 15, then 15 would stop at `Fizz`.
Chain `if / else if / else`. Remember the last case has to turn the number into text.
`String(n)` or `` `${n}` `` turns a number into text.
explanation: The order of the branches matters: the most specific case (a multiple of both 3 and 5) has to be checked first.
